weighting: equal categories; equal animals within category; equal physical recordings within category/animal; equal cells within category/animal/recording
effect: population variance (K denominator) of model-standardized named-category means
normalization: 100 times category dispersion divided by weighted raw-cell outcome variance in the same population
rf_coordinates: display coordinates; MouseV2 fitted x+50 and y+10; Allen native released azimuth/elevation; no gaze correction

rf.support_algorithm: pending response-blind occupancy review after current-population RF completion
rf.reference: pending support gate; fixed weighted equal-population reference once supported

timescale.point: mean of ten complete draw-specific effects
timescale.bootstrap: one coherent draw per sampled MouseV2 animal/session occurrence

interval: 95% percentile interval from paired highest-independent-unit bootstrap
primary_gate: blocked until current-population RF fits, RF occupancy, recording replication, rank, influence, and simulation checks pass
